footer.tagline: Reliable support from real people, solving everyday problems with care, speed and integrity.

faq.lead: Everything you need to know about using Yellow Book. Cannot find your answer? Write to us any time.
faq.a1: Yellow Book is a place to find businesses in Mongolia and read what real customers say about them. Reviews are written by people under their own names.
faq.q2: How do I list my business?
faq.a2: Open "For businesses", fill in three short steps and submit. Our team checks the details — including your company registration number — before the page goes live.
faq.a3: Every review is read by a moderator before it is published. You can see the state of your own review at any time, and rejected reviews come with a reason.
faq.a4: Yes. The owner can post one public reply to each review. The reply is moderated as well, so both sides are held to the same standard.
